location: Convenience store, 1300 block of North Troup Street
title: Man wounded outside store before armed suspect is shot by clerk
summary: Police reported a 53-year-old man allegedly shot a 38-year-old man outside the store; the 38-year-old was treated and released. This record covers that initial alleged criminal shooting. The same event's fatal defensive shooting of the 53-year-old by the store clerk is indexed separately as LC-2026-1025B so each shooting keeps its own category.
status: Suspect died in the linked defensive shooting; names not released

updates.summary: WCTV report attributed to VPD on the same event.
Valdosta Daily Times follow-up: VPD says the clerk's shooting was self-defense.

location: Convenience store, 1300 block of North Troup Street
title: Store clerk fatally shoots armed man in reported self-defense
summary: After allegedly shooting a man outside, the 53-year-old entered the store armed and threatened the clerk, who shot and killed him. VPD described the clerk's shooting as self-defense and reported no charges. Classified as reported defensive, consistent with LC-2026-1001; the initial wounding is LC-2026-1025A.
status: VPD reports self-defense; clerk not charged

updates.summary: Valdosta Daily Times: VPD says the fatal shooting was self-defense.

location: Dollar General, 2100 block of Bemiss Road
title: Man injured in reported defensive shooting at store
summary: Police reported one man shot during a confrontation at a Dollar General after a bystander intervened in an alleged assault. The man survived and was released from hospital. Police said the bystander would not face charges. Non-gunshot injuries from the reported assault are excluded from these firearm counts.
status: Police reported no charges against the shooter; alleged assault charges reported against the injured man

location: 700 block, East Brookwood Drive
title: Fatal shooting involving sheriff’s deputies
summary: The GBI reported that a woman died after being shot by Lowndes County deputies in Valdosta. The release describes an active investigation. This fatality is classified separately from alleged criminal shootings.
status: Investigation ongoing in cited release

location: Brittany Woods Apartments, 1150 Old Statenville Road
title: Child injured in reported accidental discharge at apartment
summary: Police reported a ten-year-old with a gunshot injury after a firearm discharged at an apartment. The child was stable in the cited update. The reported account of children playing with the gun was disputed by the injured child’s mother. This entry follows the source’s accidental-discharge description while preserving that dispute.
status: Reckless-conduct charges reported; circumstances disputed by the victim’s family

location: Ashton Park Apartments, 1300 block of River Street
title: One killed, one injured in apartment shooting
summary: Police reported a twenty-four-year-old died after being shot at an apartment complex. An August 21 update links a seventeen-year-old with an abdominal gunshot wound to the same exchange of gunfire. Both people are counted in this one incident, including the injured suspect. Two arrests were reported. The separate July 27 homicide is not counted again.
status: Two arrests reported in August 21 update; charges are allegations and court outcome is unverified

location: Prospers Apartments, 1503 East Park Avenue
title: Man killed in apartment-complex shooting
summary: Police reported one man found unresponsive in a vehicle after an exchange of gunfire at an apartment complex. He was pronounced dead at the scene. The cited release reports one fatal victim; no additional injured person is identified. Murder warrants were reported for two suspects. Charges are allegations.
status: Murder warrants reported July 28; later disposition not verified

location: Party at a residence, 2100 block of Robin Street
title: Man critically injured in shooting at party
summary: Police reported a 36-year-old man was shot after an argument at a party around 8:20 p.m. and was in critical but stable condition after emergency surgery. A 43-year-old Perry man was arrested. Separate from the July 27 Prospers Apartments homicide.
status: Arrest reported; court outcome unverified

updates.summary: Valdosta Daily Times report on the arrest.

location: 500 block of Old Hudson Street
title: Man shot in leg during attempted armed robbery
summary: Police reported a 62-year-old man was shot once in the lower leg, a non-life-threatening injury, during an attempted armed robbery around 8:30 a.m. Warrants were issued for a 25-year-old suspect.
status: Suspect sought as of July 30; charges are allegations

updates.summary: Valdosta Daily Times report on the same incident.
Lanier County News: suspect still sought.

location: Residence, 500 block of Mack Drive
title: Two dead in apparent murder-suicide at Mack Drive home
summary: Officers answering a threat-of-self-harm call heard a gunshot, forced entry, and found a 29-year-old woman dead and a 32-year-old man with an apparent self-inflicted gunshot wound; he later died. A toddler was unharmed. Police called it an apparent murder-suicide. The man's gunshot is confirmed; the woman's cause of death is not stated outright in the cited sources.
status: Apparent murder-suicide per VPD; cause of death for one victim not stated
flags: One victim's cause of death not stated in sources

updates.summary: WALB report on the same incident.
Lanier County News refers to 'the shootings' and Valdosta's second domestic murder-suicide in recent days.

location: Outside a workplace, 200 block of South Lee Street
title: Two dead in domestic murder-suicide outside workplace
summary: Police reported a 56-year-old man shot his ex-wife, 46, multiple times outside her workplace and then shot himself. Both died. The two fatalities are one homicide and one self-inflicted death.
status: Murder-suicide per VPD; no prosecution expected

updates.summary: Valdosta Daily Times report on the same incident.
WALB report on the same incident.

location: 800 block of Stillwater Drive
title: Teen injured in Stillwater Drive shooting
summary: Police described gunfire during a reported transaction on Stillwater Drive. A teenager arrived at hospital with a gunshot injury and was later reported to be recovering after transfer for further care. One gunshot injury is indexed; additional people being present does not imply additional injuries.
status: Arrest warrants reported in July; final disposition not verified

dateBasis: Incident date confirmed by WALB follow-up
location: Walmart, 3274 Inner Perimeter Road
title: Shopper injured in reported accidental discharge
summary: Police reported one shopper injured by an apparent accidental firearm discharge at Walmart on June 9. The injury was described as non-life-threatening. A June 10 WALB follow-up confirms the incident date and reports a reckless-conduct arrest. This corrects the earlier publication-date fallback without adding another incident.
status: Reckless-conduct arrest reported; court outcome not verified

updates.summary: Follow-up confirms June 9 incident date and reports an arrest for reckless conduct. Record ID retained for existing correction references.

location: Park Chase Apartments, 1100 Old Statenville Road
title: Teen injured in reported accidental shooting
summary: A republished Valdosta Police release reported a teenager injured in a shooting at an apartment complex. Investigators described the discharge as accidental. The reported injury is counted as nonfatal based on the cited release.
status: Accidental classification in cited release

dateBasis: Wednesday incident date inferred from May 14 publication
location: 1700 block of Forsyth Place
title: Teen grazed by gunfire as homes struck
summary: Police reported an eighteen-year-old with a bullet graze to his arm after gunfire struck several residences. He was treated and released at the scene. Two arrests were reported. The source says Wednesday night; May 13 is inferred from its Thursday, May 14 publication.
status: Two arrests and charges reported; court outcome not established

location: Jay Boy’s Travel Center, 3661 Madison Highway
title: One killed, three injured at travel center
summary: WALB, citing the Lowndes County Sheriff’s Office, reported four people shot at a Madison Highway travel center: one died and three were hospitalized. The report says a suspect was taken into custody and faced murder charges. Charges are allegations, not a conviction.
status: Arrest and charges reported; disposition not established

location: Boardwalk Ultra Lounge, 2159 Bemiss Road
title: Man injured in shooting outside lounge
summary: Police reported one man with a gunshot wound to his leg outside a lounge. He was taken to hospital and reported stable. Arrest warrants were reported; charges are allegations.
status: Arrest warrants reported May 7; later disposition not verified

dateBasis: Incident date confirmed by corroborating local report
location: 900–1000 blocks of East Gordon Street
title: Teen injured in East Gordon Street shooting
summary: Police reported a seventeen-year-old with a gunshot wound to the torso found in the 900 block after gunfire was reported in the 1000 block. He was hospitalized and transferred to Florida, reported critical but stable. No injuries were reported inside the nearby home struck by gunfire. One injured person is indexed.
status: Investigation ongoing in cited report; later outcome unverified

updates.summary: Corroborating report explicitly dates the incident April 24 at 11:35 p.m.

location: 4900 block of White Water Road, unincorporated Lowndes County
title: Reported shooting on White Water Road (unconfirmed: victim not reported hit)
summary: An LCSO field case report described a reported shooting / aggravated assault with a gun and named a 49-year-old City of Valdosta manager as the victim. Neither cited article says she was struck by gunfire, so this record counts 0 injured and adds no one to people-shot totals until a source confirms an injury.
status: Two men later charged (aggravated assault, firearm during a felony); court outcome unverified

updates.summary: Follow-up: a man initially listed as a witness surrendered May 4 and was charged; a second man was also charged.

location: Apartments, 1500 block of East Park Avenue
title: Woman injured in reported domestic shooting
summary: A police release reported one woman found in a vehicle with gunshot wounds and taken to hospital in critical but stable condition. Investigators described an alleged domestic shooting. The later arrest is an update to this same incident and is not counted as another shooting.
status: Suspect arrest reported September 26; court outcome not established

updates.summary: WALB, attributing VPD, reported the suspect was arrested in Texas on September 26 and would undergo extradition. The March incident remains a single archive record.

dateBasis: Date deputies found victim, as reported by sheriff
location: 500 block of Myddleton Road, Lowndes County
title: Man found dead in Myddleton Road shooting investigation
summary: The sheriff’s office reported deputies found one man dead from an apparent gunshot wound on February 11. Two arrest warrants were reported. A later update reports both suspects taken into custody in Berrien County; those arrests do not create another Lowndes shooting record. No other gunshot victim is identified in the cited reports.
status: Both suspects arrested February 26–27; court outcome not verified

updates.summary: WALB reports one suspect captured February 26 and the second February 27 in Berrien County.

dateBasis: Discovery date; Friday January 16 inferred from January 20 report and corroborated by national listing
location: 3200 block of Skipper Bridge Road, Lowndes County
title: Man found dead with gunshot wound on Skipper Bridge Road
summary: The sheriff’s office reported one man found dead with an apparent gunshot wound in the 3200 block of Skipper Bridge Road. A suspect was arrested in Tallahassee. January 16 is the discovery date; the exact time of the shooting is not established. Other deaths discussed in the suspect’s Florida cases are outside Lowndes County and excluded.
status: Suspect arrest reported in Florida; Lowndes homicide charges reported; court outcome unverified

updates.summary: National memorial listing corroborates the January 16 date and links to the WCTV report. It is a discovery aid, not a complete county tally.

location: Convenience store, 1400 block of East Park Avenue
title: Store clerk injured in convenience-store shooting
summary: Police reported a store clerk with an apparent gunshot wound to the torso after a convenience-store shooting. The clerk was taken to hospital with injuries described as non-life-threatening. Two arrests were reported on January 9. Multiple wounds to the same person are counted as one person injured.
status: Two arrests and charges reported; investigation ongoing in cited report
